spans.s: उद्वत्सर m. A year.
उद्वपन n. 1. A gift, donation; 2. pouring out.
उद्वमन m. Ejecting, vomiting.
उद्वर्त m. 1. A remainder, a surplus; 2. excess, preponderance; 3. cleaning the body with perfumes.

उद्वर्तन n. 1. Ascending; 2. turning from side to side, springing, चटुलशफरोद्वर्तनप्रेक्षितानि Megh.i.40; 3. prosperity, elevation; 4. grinding, pounding; 5. rubbing and cleansing the body with unguents.
उद्वर्धन n. Sly or suppressed laughter.

उद्वह m. 1. A son; 2. one who continues the lineage (in this sense generally used as the last member of compounds), उदयमस्तमयं च रघूद्वहात् R.ix.9 (Mall. however, renders उद्वह by नायक here), पार्थिवीमुदवहद्रघूद्वहः xi.45; 3. one of the seven courses of air; 4. marriage.

उद्वाह m. Marriage, wedding, असवर्णां सवयं ज्ञेयो विधिरुद्वाहकर्मणि M.iii.43. (There are eight forms of marriage mentioned in the Smṛtis - 1. ब्राह्म, 2. देव, 3. आर्ष, 4. प्राजापत्य, 5. आसुर, 6. गांधर्व, 7. राक्षस, 8. पैशाच.)
उद्वहन n. 1. Lifting up, bearing, carrying, R.ii.18, xiii.8, K.S.iii.13; 2. riding, R.xiv.20; 3. marrying.
उद्वान (I) a. (f. ना) Vomited.
उद्वान (II) m. Ejecting, vomiting.
उद्वान (I) a. (f. ना) Vomited.
उद्वांत a. (f. ता) 1. Vomited; 2. without rut, as an elephant.
उद्वांत a. (f. ता) 1. Vomited; 2. without rut, as an elephant.
उद्वांति f. The same as उद्वमन q.v.
उद्वाप m. 1. Ejection; 2. shaving; 3. nonexistence of a subsequent consequent on the absence of an antecedent (in logic).
उद्वास m. 1. Banishment; 2. abandonment; 3. killing.
उद्वासन n. 1. Banishment; 2. abandonment; 3. killing.
उद्वाहनी f. A cowri (वराटिका).
उद्वाहिक a. (f. की) Relating to marriage (as a mantra), M.ix.65.
उद्वाहिक a. (f. की) Relating to marriage (as a mantra), M.ix.65.
उद्वाहिनी f. A rope.
उद्विग्न a. (f. ग्ना) Sorrowful, anxious, vacant-minded.
उद्विग्न a. (f. ग्ना) Sorrowful, anxious, vacant-minded.
उद्वीक्षण n. 1. Looking up or upwards; 2. sight, seeing, looking at, R.iii.1.
उद्वृंहण n. Increase.
उद्वेग (I) m. 1. Trembling, shaking; 2. agitation, excitement, anxiety, Bg.xii.15; 3. regret, sorrow; 4. fear, शांतोद्वेगस्तिमितनयनं दृष्टभक्तिर्भवान्या Megh.i.36; 5. astonishment.
उद्वेग (II) n. A betel-nut (fruit).
उद्वेजन n. 1. Agitation, anxiety; 2. infliction of pain, उद्वेजनकरैर्दंडैश्छिन्नयित्वा प्रवासयेत् M.viii.352.
उद्वेदि a. Furnished with an elevated altar, विमानं नवमुद्वेदि R.xvii.9.
उद्वेप m. Shaking, trembling.
उद्वेल a. (f. ला) 1. Overflowing its banks, R.x.34; 2. transgressing the proper limit.
उद्वेल a. (f. ला) 1. Overflowing its banks, R.x.34; 2. transgressing the proper limit.
उद्वेष्टन (I) a. (f. ना) Loosened, कयाचिदुद्वेष्टनवांतमाल्यः R.vii.6, K.S.vii.57.
उद्वेष्टन (II) n. 1. the act of surrounding; 2. an enclosure; 3. pain in the buttocks.
उद्वेष्टन (I) a. (f. ना) Loosened, कयाचिदुद्वेष्टनवांतमाल्यः R.vii.6, K.S.vii.57.
उद्वोढृ m. A husband.
